name: fal
description: fal lets agents find image, video, and audio generation models and run them with the signed-in fal account. Each user signs in to their own fal account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which fal models can turn a product photo into a short video?
Generate a square image of a lighthouse at dawn in a flat illustration style.
What inputs and options does the FLUX image model take on fal?

apps.name: fal
apps.description: Model search and image, video, and audio generation, over fal's MCP server with browser sign-in.
